name: Window position
author: Dave Brownell
description: Where the focused window sits in the scrolling layout

barWidget.description: Carousel pips showing the focused window's place in the scrolling layout, with a hover readout

schema.label: Style
schema.description: Pips, a numeric counter, or both.

schema.label: Max pips
schema.description: Fall back to the counter once the workspace holds more columns than this.

schema.label: Max dwindle windows
schema.description: Under the dwindle layout, fall back to the counter once the workspace holds more windows than this. Dwindle stacks several windows into a column, so the pips run out of room to split well before the column count reaches Max pips.

schema.label: Poll interval (ms)
schema.description: How often to re-check the window arrangement. Hyprland emits no event when windows are repositioned, so this is the only way to notice a swap.
